data.content_ref: inline:The target's refusal criteria include a 'causal fingerprint' countercondition: resumption must be refused when 'the causal fingerprint of the resumed stream diverges from the fingerprint an uninterrupted run would produce.' But this is circular as a pre-resumption gate. To compute the resumed stream's fingerprint you must actually resume; to compute the uninterrupted-run fingerprint you must complete a run that was halted by token-budget exhaustion. Neither fingerprint is available at the decision point, so the criterion cannot operationalize the 'exactly when resumption must stay refused' demand the problem poses. The target thus imports a non-actionable test dressed as a covering principle, leaving the refusal boundary it was asked to determine still undetermined.
